title: Horrible canning experience; rims are "sticky"; golden lids don't seal; stick with Ball
text:
Horrible canning experience; rims are "sticky"; golden lids don't seal; stick with Ball. This is a 40-pack set of mason jars with:
- 30 sliver lids with rims
- 10 golden lids with rims
- 1 tiny brush
- 40 chalkboard labels with chalk marker

I only ever used Ball jars, lids, and rims in the past and now I know why. I had an opportunity to try this and CANNOT recommend them.

I spent hours water bath canning only to discover that the golden lids DO NOT SEAL at all--that is 25% of the jars. In the fourth photo, the gold rim and lid is to the left of the picture. The silver lids appear to seal but the rims on about 90% of the jars are almost impossible to screw on. They are very sticky. After having the bad experience with the golden lids and using 14 of the jars with lids and rims, I decided to use my Ball canning set instead . When using a Ball rim, they glide on these jars. I have a funny feeling that because the rims are so bad, that the seal is broken periodically as a result of unscrewing the rim and checking if the lid is holding. For the golden lids, they just do not seal at all, whether the rims are good or not.

I see no reason for the tiny brush. The 40 chalkboard labels are very nice as they cover the entire lid and peel off and stick on easily (seventh photo). The chalk marker is okay. The jars themselves are good. If you find yourself stuck with this garbage, just go out and buy Ball lids and rims that will fit these jars and they will become usable. I do not trust these lids and rims at all--TERRIBLE.

If sealing a jar during canning is not a concern, then these jars, lids, and rims are usable even if the rim is hard to screw on. However, I only use canning jars for hot water bath canning, so I have to throw out all these lids and rims.

I would personally never buy this set after having tried it. The free brush, labels, and marker can always be purchased separately. Stick with Ball which is priced not much more than this and works every time.
